source.author: Claude research run (Opus 5.5 orchestrator, Haiku 5.5 xhigh subagents)
source.notes: Rule = the channel's own stated plan (close 1/2 at TP1, move stop to entry, hold the rest); the final 'open' target is not expressible, so the rest closes at TP3. Written after the 2-signal pilot had been seen; it was not chosen among alternatives and has no evidence either way.

recommendations.not_executed: Recommendations are informational and never executed. The profile stays inactive until an operator approves and activates it.

research_basis.candidate: Provider plan: 50% at TP1 then stop to entry, 50% at TP3 (the channel's 'open' 4th target is not expressible)
research_basis.entry_model: E2 = project pending_at_range (both observed signals were limit-style zones away from the market; E1/E3 market entries filled 0 of 2)
research_basis.data: 2 signals from 1 day (2026-10-26), Go forwarder store; Dukascopy XAUUSD ticks; specs read from the Vantage demo bridge on 2026-10-27 (contract 100, tick 0.01 = 1 USD, min/step 0.01).

recommendations.evidence_summary: No evidence. Pilot (descriptive, n=2, E2/MID): one BUY reached TP3 (+2.7R single exit at TP3), one SELL hit its stop (-1.0R). A sample of 2 cannot detect any effect.
known_gaps: The live Go parser does not recognise this channel's 'BUY ZONE / STOPLOSS / TAKE PROFIT a - b - c - open' format: on 2026-10-26 the forwarder classified the signal message as kind 'cancel'. No signal from this channel can reach the executor until the parser supports the format.
The channel is not a configured source chat (events end 'chat_not_configured'); execution mode is 'disabled'.
One message carries two signals ('SIGNAL 3', 'SIGNAL 4'); trade-set ids are per message in the executor, so the second signal would collide unless the id includes the signal label.
Stop edits: the first published stop of SIGNAL 4 (4028) was a typo corrected 27 minutes later (4018), 48 s after price reached the zone. max_distance_price 15.0 would have refused the typo version.
infeasible_split skip_trade: a 50/50 split needs at least 0.02 lots, i.e. about 6,400 USD equity at 0.25% risk for an 8 USD stop.
Vantage commission, swap, margin and in-session spread beyond one Asian-session quote (0.29 USD on 2026-10-27T02:25Z) are Unknown.
activation_blockers: Parser support for the channel's format (code change in the Go forwarder/domain parser, owner-approved).
At least 160 signals of history evaluated under the pre-registered protocol with a CI entirely above zero; today the verdict is Unknown.
recommendations.forward_test_advice: Do not forward-test for profit. If the owner wants an operations test, use the demo account only, after the parser supports the format.
recommendations.validation_note: Validated in memory with version 1 injected against the TypeScript validators and the live Go domain validator. See profile_validation_output.txt.
recommendations.audit_warning: AUDIT WARNING 2026-10-27: no performance evidence (n=2). The channel is a free marketing funnel for a paid group (LUCAS MASTERMIND); its recaps report best-case floating pips (e.g. +360 pips measured from the zone's best price to the day's high; a SELL that hit its posted stop was reported as '+60 pips' and 'returned to breakeven'). Treat every published result as unverified.
